info.title: Typed QA and PM handoff — implemented Q01–Q03
info.description: Enabled current session and active same-project membership. ADMIN requires that membership. Reads allowed on archived projects. QA work_items identity/status/version remain authoritative; QA never changes BUG/retest/execution state. Discovery uses generic work-items/metadata canCreateQa and statusesByType.QA; ordinary canCreate does not grant QA. No typed /qa/metadata route exists. See markdown contract for transactional lifecycle policy. Bean Validation constraints return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; malformed JSON and parameter type binding return 400 INVALID_REQUEST.

post.description: Current project PM or TESTER, global role not DEV, unarchived project. Immutable question/source; server creator/status/type/time; initial open/generation0/unassigned. Consistent source optional, COMMITTED document and active source case. Exact actor/key/action/resource/body replay reauthorizes current context and returns saved response; key/body mismatch is 409. Failed commands leave no key.
